entries.title: Isaiah 45:1
segments: So says the LORD to His anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have made strong in order to humble nations before him. And I will loosen the loins of kings, to open before him the two-leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut.

entries.title: Isaiah 45:2
segments: I will go before you, and make hills level. I will break in pieces the bronze gates, and cut the iron bars in two.

entries.title: Isaiah 45:3
segments: And I will give you the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that you may know that I [am] the LORD, who calls [you] by your name, the God of Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 45:4
segments: For Jacob My servant's sake, and Israel My chosen, I have even called you by your name; I have named you, though you have not known me.

entries.title: Isaiah 45:5
segments: I [am] the LORD, and [there is] none else, no God besides Me; I clothed you, though you have not known Me;

entries.title: Isaiah 45:6
segments: that they may know from the rising of the sun, and to the sunset, that [there is] none besides Me. I [am] the LORD, and there is none else;

entries.title: Isaiah 45:7
segments: forming the light and creating darkness; making peace and creating evil. I the LORD do all these [things].

entries.title: Isaiah 45:8
segments: Drop down from above, O heavens, and let the clouds pour down righteousness. Let the earth open, and let salvation bear fruit; and let righteousness spring up together. I the LORD have created it.'

entries.title: Isaiah 45:9
segments: Woe to him who fights with the One who formed him, a potsherd among the potsherds of the earth! Shall the clay say to its former, What are you making? Or your work, He [has] no hands?

entries.title: Isaiah 45:10
segments: Woe to him who says to [his] father, What are you fathering? Or to the woman, What are you laboring over?

entries.title: Isaiah 45:11
segments: So says the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, and the One who formed him, Do you ask Me of things to come? Do you give command to Me about My sons, and about the work of My hands?

entries.title: Isaiah 45:12
segments: I have made the earth, and created man on it; I [with] My hands have stretched out the heavens; and all their host have I commanded.

entries.title: Isaiah 45:13
segments: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will direct all his ways; he shall build My city, and he shall let My captives go, not for price nor reward, says the LORD of hosts.

entries.title: Isaiah 45:14
segments: So says the LORD, The labor of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia, and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come to you, and they shall be yours. They shall come after you in chains; and they shall cross in chains and they shall fall down to you. They shall plead to you, [saying], Surely God [is] in you; and none else, no [other] God.

entries.title: Isaiah 45:15
segments: Truly You [are] a God who hides Yourself, O God of Israel, the Savior.

entries.title: Isaiah 45:16
segments: They shall be ashamed, and also confounded, all of them; they [who are] makers of idols shall go into disgrace together.

entries.title: Isaiah 45:17
segments: [But] Israel shall be saved in the LORD [with] an everlasting salvation. You shall not be ashamed nor blush to the forevers of eternity.

entries.title: Isaiah 45:18
segments: For so says the LORD the Creator of the heavens, He [is] God, forming the earth and making it; He makes it stand, not creating it empty, [but] forming it to be inhabited. I [am] the LORD, and [there is] no other.

entries.title: Isaiah 45:19
segments: I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth. I did not say to the seed of Jacob, Seek me in vain. I the LORD speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.

entries.title: Isaiah 45:20
segments: Gather yourselves and come; draw near together, escaped ones of the nations; those who set up the wood of their graven image, and those that pray to a god [that] cannot save. They know nothing.

entries.title: Isaiah 45:21
segments: Declare and bring near; yea, let them take counsel together. Who has declared this of old? [Who] has told it from then? Is it not I, the LORD? And [there is] no other God besides Me; a just God and a Savior; there is none besides Me.

entries.title: Isaiah 45:22
segments: Turn to Me, and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I [am] God, and there [is] no other.

entries.title: Isaiah 45:23
segments: I have sworn by Myself, the word has gone out of My mouth [in] righteousness, and shall not return, that to Me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.

entries.title: Isaiah 45:24
segments: He says, Only in the LORD do I have righteousness and strength; even to Him he comes. And they are ashamed, all who are angry with Him.

entries.title: Isaiah 45:25
segments: In the LORD shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.
